vectors.name: saturn-kronos-keeps-the-same-backup-ram-elsewhere
vectors.rationale: Beetle Saturn's .bkr and Kronos's kronos/saturn/<stem>.ram are the same 32 KiB of backup RAM; Kronos's backup cartridge depends on an option its save answer does not read, so whether it keeps one is unestablished and the answer says why. Beetle's .smpc is the console's own clock and settings, no part of the game's save, and the record sets it aside with its citation (#577 D13).

vectors.name: saturn-kronos-with-beetle-saves-reads-beetles-files-in-place
vectors.rationale: With kronos_use_beetle_saves enabled Kronos opens <stem>.bkr and puts a 4 Mbit backup cartridge in at <stem>.bcr in the save directory, the files Beetle Saturn wrote, in the same layout: both read in place, and the save carries over whole — the .smpc beside them is the console's, not the game's (#577 D13).

vectors.name: a-system-no-format-record-covers-states-why-it-is-unestablished
vectors.rationale: No packaged save-format record covers either Game Boy core yet, so both sides say so and the pair is unestablished rather than guessed from the file names.
